sloka: वाग्भिः परमतुष्टाभिरभिष्टोतुं प्रचक्रमे ।ततः सूतो यथाकालं पार्थिवस्य निवेशने ॥२-१४-४६॥
transliteration: vāgbhiḥ paramatuṣṭābhirabhiṣṭotuṁ pracakrame ।tataḥ sūto yathākālaṁ pārthivasya niveśane ॥2-14-46॥

translations.english: Thereafter the charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment of the king, and with folded hands began singing the praise of the lord of the earth appropriate to the hour.
